name: Site readiness
description: The only inputs a requester can supply. Validated, not arbitrary extra vars. Cluster name, base domain, VIPs and MACs are NOT asked for - they are derived from the bundle, which is the source of truth.

spec.question_description: true = Lab. Demo mode: the sample bundle and DNS fixtures in this repository are used, nothing real is contacted, and no installation media is produced. false = Production: live bundle URL, live resolvers, real hardware.
Lab only. failing_dns omits the api-int record and the DNS branch fails predictably. passing resolves every record and the run reaches the approval gate.
Lab only. simulated reports what the branch would do against real Redfish. skipped records that it was deliberately not run.
Team that must authorise execution. Recorded in the readiness report as approval_requested_from, so the evidence names who was asked.
Production only. Ignored in demo mode, where the sample bundle in demo/bundle/ is used instead.
